items.title: Gene regulation ki ahmiyat aur tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene regulation (PDF 141-142).

blocks.text: Regulation cells ko mahol ke halaat ka jawab dene aur zaroorat par proteins banane deti hai. Kaseer-ul-khaliya (multicellular) jandaron mein yeh cells ki tafreeq (differentiation) aur shakal sazi (morphogenesis) ki bunyad hai, jis se aik genome wale lekin mukhtalif genes zahir karne wale cells bante hain.

Regulation kai darjon par hoti hai: transcription ki raftaar, transcription ke baad mRNA ki tabdeeli, translation ki raftaar, aur translation ke baad protein ki tabdeeli (us ka murna, istehkaam waghaira).

items: Negative regulation: repressors naam ke regulatory proteins promoter ke qareeb operators naam ke DNA hisson se jur kar RNA polymerase ko rokte aur transcription band ya kam karte hain.

Positive regulation: activators naam ke regulatory proteins regulatory site se jur kar RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad dete aur transcription shuru ya tez karte hain. Kitab kehti hai ke activators, jinhein woh inducers bhi kehti hai, operators se jurte hain.

blocks.alt: Do DNA pattiyan, har aik mein promoter, regulatory site aur gene. Oopar, negative regulation: surkh repressor operator par baitha aur RNA polymerase guzar nahi sakta, transcription ruk ya dheemi. Neeche, positive regulation: hara activator promoter par RNA polymerase ke saath aur lamba teer transcription shuru ya tez hone ko dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Negative aur positive regulation (Figure 19.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Genes mein regulatory silsile hote hain jin se regulatory proteins jurte hain. Negative regulation mein repressor promoter ke qareeb operator se jur kar RNA polymerase ko rokta, transcription band ya kam karta hai. Positive regulation mein activator regulatory site se jur kar RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad deta, transcription shuru ya tez karta hai.

blocks.title: Activators aur inducers
blocks.text: Aksar hawalon mein inducer activator protein nahi hota: yeh chhota molecule (jaise koi sugar) hai jo gene on karta hai, aksar repressor se jur kar use operator se hata deta hai. Activators promoter ke qareeb apni regulatory sites se jurte hain.

Eukaryotes mein mRNA ki splicing ke dauran bhi genes on ya off ho sakte hain. Khaas cells ke khaas regulatory proteins mRNA ke hisse, introns ya exons, mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalte hain, is liye mukhtalif lambai ke mRNAs bante aur aik gene se aik se zyada polypeptides ban sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Aik pre-mRNA, exons 1, 2, 3 aur 4, darmiyan surmai intron lakeerein. Teer do qisam ke cells tak: A mein mRNA exons 1, 2 aur 4 rakhta, B mein 1, 3 aur 4, aur har aik alag protein banata hai jo teen rangeen motiyon se dikhaya gaya.
blocks.caption: Alternative splicing (Figure 19.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Eukaryotes mein genes splicing ke dauran bhi qaboo ho sakte hain. Khaas cells ke khaas regulatory proteins tay karte hain ke pre-mRNA ke kaun se hisse nikalein, introns ya exons bhi, is liye aik gene se mukhtalif lambai ke mRNAs bante hain aur us se aik se zyada polypeptides ban sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik gene do mukhtalif proteins kaise de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Alternative splicing se: mukhtalif cells mein mukhtalif exons rakhe jate hain, jis se mukhtalif mRNAs aur is liye mukhtalif polypeptides bante hain.

items: Regulation se jawab, tafreeq aur shakal sazi.
Operator par repressor: off; activator: on ya tez.
Alternative splicing: aik gene se kai proteins.
